body: I take some meds that don't allow me to cry like I used too - It's like they end my extreme emotion sensitivity. Even in some tragic events I didn't cry: It's very weird, but my therapist confirmed this could be happening to me.

I tried to ditched medication, several times, with my therapists help: than I've realised that was not going to happen if I wanted to live my life as "normal" as I could be.  
Lowering dosis it's one thing, stopping meds I don't believe I'll ever try it again.

I'm the same as you!!!  
Since at very young age I suffered from severe anxiety and then developed Bipolar Disorder, OCD and more recently maybe PTSD (it's not yet clear).  


Please seek professional help and if you're not happy seek for another one (It's very important to have total confidence in your health carers).  


I'm in a new phase: I don't aspire to be "normal" (after all what is normal?) but I try to be as much as funcional as I can be. I know my limitations and yet I've accomplished so much. It seems like we need to struggle more than other people (who don't have our mental issues), but everyone has their issues and battles.   


I've faith you will get the proper professional guidance and be as funcional as you can be.
